question: How are the starting player and ordinary turn sequence determined, does play use formal rounds, and how many regular actions do you take on a turn before resolving any additional effects or bonuses?
expected_answer: Randomly determine the starting player. Normal turns proceed clockwise. Ark Nova has no formal rounds: players take one turn at a time until game end is triggered, with breaks interrupting play as required. On an ordinary turn perform one action, which may trigger additional effects or bonuses.
material_requested_facts: Normal turns proceed clockwise, without formal rounds.
A normal turn contains one action, potentially triggering additional effects and bonuses.
source_references: Main PDF p5 global setup 7: Randomly determine a start player. Turn order is clockwise.
Main PDF p6 Gameplay, first two paragraphs: no formal rounds; turns clockwise; one action per turn, possibly triggering additional effects and bonuses.
novelty_reason: No active prompt requests random selection of the start player, absence of formal rounds, or the one-normal-action-per-turn restriction. Q03 requests card movement/strength/timing, and Q19 requests break administration; neither requests these rules. Clockwise order is repeated context, not additional novelty credit.
